beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The projector's dead. Usually I talk you down, but today I need you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can use my laptop. Nobody's going to die.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep saying that while I imagine twelve directors sharing one screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My laptop's dead too. We're finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody's going to die. I'll print twelve copies. You count them; twelve is less frightening when it's just paper.

reason: A5 previously introduced a thirteenth copy with no explained recipient; the replacement gives B a small task using the established twelve-person anxiety while reversing reassurance roles.
comparison: S225-b turns the frightening director count into manageable paper; S225-a swaps repair tools and towels as confidence reverses.
scope: Local writer revision only; no technical retries or fresh-review correction counters changed.
